maddeler.e:
نتشاءم (form VI)
# نَتَشَاءَمُ (natašāʔamu) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʔa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# نَتَشَاءَمَ (natašāʔama) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʔa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
# نَتَشَاءَمْ (natašāʔam) /na.ta.ʃaː.ʔam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَشَاءَمَ (tašāʔama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
